export.formula: reconstructed candidate + staging final generation + copied final generation

limits: Output-byte caps do not prove 2GiB fit, runtime or whole-process RSS. Oversized generations refuse without finalization.
SQLite is separate from final-generation bounds; logs, metadata, sidecars and transport overhead need reservation margin.
Original sources remain read-only; no source-body copy/download, cache cleanup or foreign reservation release is planned.
Read-only capacity observation is nontransactional; existing native parent must freshly admit each request under unchanged policy.
Host admission and sampled process/storage checks are cooperative, not kernel quotas or arbitrary descendant containment.
